name: 铜镜
subject: An ancient Chinese handheld bronze mirror, broad circular metal disc seen at a slight angle, short thick rectangular handle, warm muted bronze rim around cool desaturated reflective center with two hard square light patches. Small ring cast on handle end; unmistakably a mirror rather than coin, shield or compass.

name: 云锦囊
subject: A sturdy indigo-blue brocade drawstring pouch, gathered neck and chunky tied gold-brown cord, broad soft folded bag base, one simple pale cloud-shaped woven patch built from large square clusters. Material is thick woven cloth, not leather or a jewel. Clear three-quarter volume.

name: 玄铁腰牌
subject: A dark iron waist identification plaque suspended by a short brown leather loop. Long substantial rectangular iron plate with bevel suggested only by stepped color strips, clipped lower corners and one broad bronze inset angular emblem. Two small rivets and one deep edge chip. No letters or writing. Clearly a worn metal waist tag, not a blue banner.

name: 虎符残片
subject: One broken HALF of an ancient Chinese bronze tiger military tally. Clear crouching tiger side profile: angular feline head with two ears, heavy forepaw, long arched back and curled tail; jagged split across the torso exposing lighter bronze. Dark bronze with sparse muted green patina. Small object not a full tiger statue, no letters.
review: Rejected whole tiger draft; edited to broken front half with stepped bronze fracture, no rear legs/tail.

name: 司南
subject: An ancient Chinese south-pointing lodestone spoon resting on a thick square bronze divination board, three-quarter top-down view. Board is dark bronze with four simple pale square direction markers, center supports an unmistakable black iron ladle with round bowl and long tapering handle. Spoon prominently reads above the board, not modern compass or clock.

name: 长明烛
subject: A short old ivory beeswax candle standing in a squat dark bronze saucer with raised rim and three square feet. Heavy stepped wax drips on side, thick exposed black wick with small square orange-yellow flame. Strong dark base, muted wax body; no glow halo, no smooth gradients, no realistic lighting.

name: 龙须穗
subject: An ancient dragon-whisker tassel accessory: two long thick golden-brown whisker strands curve outward in large stepped arcs from a carved dark green jade clasp, short oxblood red binding knot at top. Two strands remain visually separated with clear empty space, organic stiff whiskers rather than hair or dangling sticks. Chunky readable cord and clasp.

name: 玉龟符
subject: A small green jade tortoise talisman, three-quarter top view; broad low dark jade shell with three large pale rectangular scute patches, clearly visible short head, four stubby feet and tiny tail. A thick brown hanging cord passes through a drilled hole near shell edge. Recognizable tortoise silhouette, not a round green gemstone.
